coverage_matrix.basic_geometry_justification: Native rectangles, paths, symbolic cells; Short symbolic DNA nucleotide row and compact one-hot cells with 1 Mb and human/mouse labels. No biological artwork.

Native rectangles, paths, symbolic cells; U-shaped convolutional encoder/decoder at selected scales 1 bp and 4 bp, with skipped intermediate scales shown by ellipses. Bottleneck Transformer Tower is 128 bp; do not show any further pooling below 128 bp. Two matched encoder-to-decoder skips. Output embedder receives restored 1-bp decoder features plus a separate 128-bp transformer tap. Pair representation branch from transformer bypasses decoder to 2D contact output.

Native rectangles, paths, symbolic cells; All eight 1-bp readout types plus histone modification and TF binding at 128 bp; native schematic aligned profile lines with donor–acceptor splice arcs, no measured data.
Native rectangles, paths, symbolic cells; Native symmetric contact matrix with diagonal plus a few off-diagonal cells at 2,048 bp; no quantitative claims.

taste_constraints: Mostly white; pale blue only in meaningful local modules; restrained green at matched skip emphasis; dark/black readable typography.
No invented quantitative results or benchmark plots. No gradients, shadows, decorated cards or title ribbons.
